_about: Illustrative catalog for the pathway recommender. Titles name widely known civilian credentials and programs so the recommendations read realistically; the summaries are written for this project and are not guidance from any certifying body, school or agency. Nothing here states eligibility, cost or funding.

pathways.title: CompTIA A+
pathways.summary: Entry-level IT support credential covering hardware, operating systems, troubleshooting and help desk work.

pathways.title: CompTIA Network+
pathways.summary: Vendor-neutral networking credential covering how networks are designed, configured, secured and repaired.

pathways.title: CompTIA Security+
pathways.summary: Baseline security credential covering threats, access control, risk management and securing networks.

pathways.title: Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)
pathways.summary: Networking credential focused on configuring and administering routed and switched enterprise networks.

pathways.title: CompTIA Cybersecurity Analyst (CySA+)
pathways.summary: Analyst credential for detecting threats, reading security data and responding to incidents.

pathways.title: CompTIA Linux+
pathways.summary: Systems administration credential for installing, configuring and scripting Linux servers.

pathways.title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
pathways.summary: Foundational cloud credential covering core services, security responsibilities and cost concepts.

pathways.title: ITIL 4 Foundation
pathways.summary: Service management framework used by IT operations and help desk teams to run services reliably.

pathways.title: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology
pathways.summary: Four-year degree in networks, systems, security and programming. Prior military IT training is often reviewed for credit.

pathways.title: Paramedic (NREMT)
pathways.summary: Advanced prehospital care credential building on EMT training: advanced airway, cardiac care and medications.

pathways.title: Emergency Medical Technician (EMT)
pathways.summary: Entry credential for emergency medical response: assessment, basic life support and patient transport.

pathways.title: Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) Program
pathways.summary: Program preparing for practical nursing licensure. Corpsman and medic experience maps closely to its clinical content.

pathways.title: Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN)
pathways.summary: Degree leading to registered nurse licensure, with clinical rotations across hospital settings.

pathways.title: Healthcare Administration Certificate
pathways.summary: Covers how clinics and hospitals are run: operations, records, compliance and leading clinical staff.

pathways.title: Instructional Design Certificate
pathways.summary: Designing courses and training material for adult learners, including how to measure whether training worked.

pathways.title: Project Management Professional (PMP)
pathways.summary: Senior project management credential for leading teams, schedules, budgets and risk on larger projects.

pathways.title: Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM)
pathways.summary: Entry project management credential covering the vocabulary and process of running a project.

pathways.title: Lean Six Sigma Green Belt
pathways.summary: Process improvement method for removing waste and variation from operations, logistics and maintenance work.

pathways.title: Bachelor of Arts in Organizational Leadership
pathways.summary: Degree in leading people and organisations. Military leadership courses are commonly reviewed for credit.

pathways.title: Commercial Driver's License (CDL) Class A
pathways.summary: License for operating combination commercial vehicles such as tractor-trailers.

pathways.title: Supply Chain Management Certificate
pathways.summary: Planning, sourcing, inventory and distribution across a supply chain.

pathways.title: Registered Electrical Apprenticeship
pathways.summary: Paid on-the-job training toward journeyman electrician status, combined with classroom instruction.

pathways.title: FCC General Radiotelephone Operator License (GROL)
pathways.summary: License for repairing and maintaining radio communications equipment.
